## How it was tested

- [ ] `swift test` passes
- [ ] The app builds
- [ ] A new or changed screen has its scene in `PreviewCatalog`
- [ ] If this changes what is read, recorded or run: a test that would have caught the wrong behavior, and SECURITY.md updated
- [ ] A line under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md, if people can see the change
